name: America.co Public Tools
tagline: Three free public tools with no account: a receipt for your federal taxes, every federal rule open for public comment, and a clear FOIA request you can send today.
indexable_why: false = staged: noindex on every page, robots.txt disallows everything, no sitemap, no IndexNow. The repository variable SITE_INDEXABLE=true makes the site indexable; the pages listed under duplicates_of_original stay noindex even then.
duplicates_why: America.co serves its own taxpayer receipt, FOIA request builder and comment-deadline list, and since November 2026 a comment calendar with a page per agency, per month and per notice. The receipt tool, the FOIA builder and every comment-deadline page here repeat those, so they stay noindex and out of the sitemap, and each links to America.co's page. America.co has no page per spending line (its /taxpayer-receipt/<line> answers 404), so the 19 spending-line pages, the home page, sources, about and data are indexed once the site is live. This site adds to the original and never replaces it.
